newsitem.title: FRANCE: Algeria may have bought some Canadian wheat - trade.
newsitem.headline: Algeria may have bought some Canadian wheat - trade.

text.p: Algeria may have bought some milling wheat from Canada but details were lacking, European grain traders said on Wednesday. There was no official confirmation of a deal.

Earlier European grain traders said Algeria was expected to cancel or delay a tender for the purchase of 75,000 tonnes of optional-origin soft wheat for September because of a sharp rise in world prices.
Some traders suggested Algeria may have bought some wheat in a closed deal with the Canadian wheat Board (CWB) and decided to pass on the more formal optional-origin tender it launched last Friday.
